items.exampleEn: There is a mouse in the kitchen!
He is sleeping on the couch.
I take a bath every night.
My dad is cutting down the old tree with a saw.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸正在用鋸子把那棵老樹鋸倒。

items.exampleEn: We eat dinner in the dining room.
We watch TV in the living room.

items.sentenceEn: The saw is in the box.

items.audioEn: A mouse is in the dining room! It is under the table.
items.audioZh: 飯廳裡有一隻老鼠！牠在桌子底下。

items.sentenceEn: The living room is very big.
Please put the bucket in the bathroom.

items.stemEn: After work, I like to take a hot ____.

items.passageEn: Our house has a big living room and a small dining room. Yesterday, my sister found a mouse in the living room. She jumped on the couch! My dad put a bucket over the mouse. Then he took the mouse outside. Now we keep the doors closed.
items.passageZh: 我們家有一間大客廳和一間小飯廳。昨天，我的姊妹在客廳發現一隻老鼠，她跳到沙發上！我爸爸用水桶把老鼠蓋住，然後把牠帶到外面。現在我們都把門關好。

questions.questionZh: 作者的姊妹在哪裡發現老鼠？
爸爸用什麼把老鼠蓋住？
